description: This Java class defines a REST controller endpoint for client operations in a Spring Boot web application. It provides methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting client data via HTTP requests, using a ClientService for business logic and ClientResourceMapper to convert between domain and resource representations.

classes.name: ClientRestEndpoint
classes.description: A REST API controller for managing client information, handling HTTP GET, POST, and DELETE requests to perform CRUD operations.

methods.name: getClientInfo
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve client info based on clientId path variable.

methods.name: createClientInfo
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create new client data from provided ClientResource.

methods.name: updateClientInfo
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update existing client data from provided ClientResource.

methods.name: deleteClientInfo
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a client based on clientId.
